name: afse-formio-workspace
description: AFSE React component library on top of the open-source Form.io renderer (@formio/js 5.x).

scripts.build: npm run build -w afse-formio-ext && npm run build -w afse-formio-react && npm run build -w afse-formio-react-native
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w afse-formio-ext && npm run typecheck -w afse-formio-react && npm run typecheck -w afse-formio-react-native && npm run typecheck -w afse-formio-playground && npm run typecheck -w afse-formio-mobile-playground
scripts.test: npm run test -w afse-formio-ext && npm run test -w afse-formio-react && npm run test -w afse-formio-react-native
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:boundaries
